summary.text: Eliot Bostar is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 29, serving since 2020 (elected 2020, re-elected 2024). His committee assignments are Banking, Commerce and Insurance and Revenue.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Bostar was born May 5, 1987, in New York and graduated from St. John's Northwestern Military Academy in 2005.
He earned a B.S. in business from Embry-Riddle University in 2012.
His biography lists his occupation as nonprofit executive and past service on the board of Lincoln Electric System from 2019 to 2021.
It lists him as married to Carrie Rowe since September 26, 2015, with one child.
